fusions.name: Stripping Whirl
fusions.desc: Whirls the blade, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and healing you for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gnaw to the Bone
fusions.desc: A grinding cut that deals 15 damage and uses up every affliction you have on the target, dealing 60% more damage for each one. It leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cloud of Shards
fusions.desc: Looses a swarm of blade shards around you for 10 seconds. It cuts enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1 second.

fusions.name: Stripped Field
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 4. When you reach 4, they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (18% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
